title: Here’s Where to Get Last-Minute Guns N’ Roses Tour Tickets Online
summary: The legendary rock band has tour dates across the United States in August and September.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Guns N’ Roses , with Axl, Duff, Izzy and Slash, hits the road this summer , with the tour scheduled to end in the United States on Sept. 19 at Truist Park in Atlanta, Georgia. The legendary rock band will then travel to Asia, Australia and New Zealand for the rest of 2026.

A rotating lineup of artists are set to support, with Public Enemy, The Barbarians of California, The Black Crowes, Ice Cube, Pierce the Veil and XCOMM all set for opening slots across the tour.

Shop Guns n' Roses Tour Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Guns N’ Roses tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.
